name: signup-onboard
description: Full signup + onboarding flow. Opens Notion signup page, fills email, gets verification code from email worker, submits it, then creates workspace + space_view + finishes onboarding (matching HAR Phase A-K). After this, the account is fully onboarded and ready for use. This macro REPLACES the Python run_full() flow — it's the same sequence of API calls, just executed locally by the extension.

steps.function: const btns = document.querySelectorAll('div[role="button"]'); for (const b of btns) { if (b.innerText.trim() === 'Continue') { b.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } return { clicked: false };

(args) => { try { const data = JSON.parse(args.body); if (!data.results || !data.results.length) return { code: null, reason: 'no emails yet' }; const email = data.results[0]; const text = (email.text_body || '') + '\n' + (email.html_body || ''); const layers = [ { name: 'html_pre', regex: /<pre[^>]*font-family:\s*monospace[^>]*>\s*([A-Za-z0-9]{4,10})\s*<\/pre>/i }, { name: 'text_line', regex: /^[ \t]*([A-Za-z0-9]{4,10})[ \t]*$/m }, { name: 'contextual', regex: /(?:login\s+code|verification\s+code|temporary\s+code|passcode|signup\s+code).{0,30}?([A-Za-z0-9]{4,10})\b/i } ]; for (const layer of layers) { const m = text.match(layer.regex); if (m) { const code = m[1]; if (code.length >= 4 && code.length <= 10 && /^[A-Za-z0-9]+$/.test(code)) return { code }; } } return { code: null, reason: 'all extraction layers failed — Notion may have changed the email format' }; } catch(e) { return { code: null, error: e.message }; } }
const btns = document.querySelectorAll('div[role="button"]'); for (const b of btns) { if (b.innerText.trim() === 'Continue') { b.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } return { clicked: false };

return new Promise((resolve) => { const check = () => { const url = window.location.href; if (url.includes('/onboarding') || (url.includes('app.notion.com') && !url.includes('/signup') && !url.includes('/login'))) { resolve({ redirected: true, url }); return; } setTimeout(check, 1000); }; check(); });

(args) => { const cookies = args.cookies || []; const map = {}; for (const c of cookies) map[c.name] = c.value; return { userId: map.notion_user_id || '', tokenV2: map.token_v2 || '', deviceId: map.notion_device_id || '' }; }
() => { return { requestId: crypto.randomUUID(), txId: crypto.randomUUID(), ts: Date.now() }; }

(args) => { try { const d = JSON.parse(args.body); if (!d.spaceId) return { ok: false, error: 'No spaceId in createSpace response', body: args.body.slice(0, 300) }; return { ok: true, spaceId: d.spaceId }; } catch(e) { return { ok: false, error: e.message }; } }
() => { return { uuid: crypto.randomUUID(), requestId: crypto.randomUUID(), txId: crypto.randomUUID(), ts: Date.now() }; }
